tasks.subject: Task 1: App scaffold, CORS/throttle base mixin, landing page + conformance
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Stand up the stac_api Django app wired into the project, with a shared base view mixin (open access, wildcard CORS, IP throttle) and the two data-free endpoints (/, /conformance/) that everything else builds on.

**Files:**
- Create: backend/stac_api/__init__.py, apps.py, base.py, utils.py, views.py, urls.py
- Create: backend/stac_api/tests/__init__.py, test_base.py, test_landing_page.py
- Modify: backend/geoquery/settings.py (INSTALLED_APPS, DEFAULT_THROTTLE_RATES)
- Modify: backend/geoquery/urls.py

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] GET /api/stac/v1/ returns a STAC Catalog with conformsTo and links
- [ ] GET /api/stac/v1/conformance/ returns conformsTo
- [ ] Every stac_api response carries Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
- [ ] permission/auth classes are actually overridden (open, not inheriting IsAuthenticatedOrReadOnly)

**Verify:** sudo docker compose exec backend uv run python manage.py test stac_api -v 2

See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-20-stac-api.md Task 1 for full code.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["backend/stac_api/__init__.py", "backend/stac_api/apps.py", "backend/stac_api/base.py", "backend/stac_api/utils.py", "backend/stac_api/views.py", "backend/stac_api/urls.py", "backend/geoquery/settings.py", "backend/geoquery/urls.py"], "verifyCommand": "sudo docker compose exec backend uv run python manage.py test stac_api -v 2", "acceptanceCriteria": ["landing page returns Catalog type with conformsTo and links", "conformance endpoint returns conformsTo", "CORS header present on all responses", "AllowAny/no-auth actually overridden"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Geometry and datetime helpers
tasks.description:

**Files:**
- Modify: backend/stac_api/utils.py
- Create: backend/stac_api/tests/test_utils.py

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] bbox_from_geometry/geojson_from_geometry handle None and real geometry
- [ ] to_rfc3339 handles None, naive-as-UTC, and non-UTC-aware datetimes, always outputs '...Z'

**Verify:** sudo docker compose exec backend uv run python manage.py test stac_api.tests.test_utils -v 2

See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-20-stac-api.md Task 2 for full code.


tasks.subject: Task 3: Collection/Item data-access layer (sources.py)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** sources.py — the single place that finds a collection (Dataset or FeatureCollection) by name and its items (DatasetResource rows, or one synthetic boundary item).

**Files:**
- Create: backend/stac_api/sources.py
- Create: backend/stac_api/tests/test_sources.py

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] get_collection_source finds active+public Dataset or FeatureCollection by name, None otherwise
- [ ] all_collection_sources combines both, name-ordered
- [ ] get_items_for_collection: DatasetResources for a Dataset, [source] for a FeatureCollection
- [ ] item_stac_id: resource.name for DatasetResource, f'{name}-item' for boundary
- [ ] get_item finds by stac id or returns None
- [ ] Dataset wins the tie-break on a name collision (documented + tested)

**Verify:** sudo docker compose exec backend uv run python manage.py test stac_api.tests.test_sources -v 2

See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-20-stac-api.md Task 3 for full code.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["backend/stac_api/sources.py"], "verifyCommand": "sudo docker compose exec backend uv run python manage.py test stac_api.tests.test_sources -v 2", "acceptanceCriteria": ["get_collection_source dataset/fc/none/inactive/private cases", "all_collection_sources combines and orders correctly", "get_items_for_collection dataset vs feature-collection branches", "item_stac_id both branches", "get_item found/not-found", "Dataset wins collision tie-break"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Collections (list + detail)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** GET /collections/ and GET /collections/{name}/, serializing Dataset/FeatureCollection sources into STAC Collection JSON.

**Files:**
- Create: backend/stac_api/serializers.py
- Modify: backend/stac_api/views.py, backend/stac_api/urls.py
- Create: backend/stac_api/tests/test_collections.py

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] GET /collections/ returns {collections: [...], links: [...]}
- [ ] GET /collections/{name}/ returns a bare Collection; 404 if missing
- [ ] bbox from spatial_extent, world-bbox fallback when unset
- [ ] FeatureCollection summaries.group_class/group_level present only when set

**Verify:** sudo docker compose exec backend uv run python manage.py test stac_api.tests.test_collections -v 2

See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-20-stac-api.md Task 4 for full code. IMPORTANT: serializers.py imports STAC_VERSION/build_url from .utils (NOT .views) to avoid a circular import — see the plan's module-layout note in Task 1.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["backend/stac_api/serializers.py", "backend/stac_api/views.py", "backend/stac_api/urls.py"], "verifyCommand": "sudo docker compose exec backend uv run python manage.py test stac_api.tests.test_collections -v 2", "acceptanceCriteria": ["collection list envelope shape correct", "collection detail 200/404", "bbox fallback to world bbox", "summaries present/absent correctly"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

- [ ] next link present/absent correctly under limit/offset

**Verify:** sudo docker compose exec backend uv run python manage.py test stac_api.tests.test_items -v 2

tasks.subject: Task 6: Search endpoint
tasks.description:
**Goal:** GET/POST /api/stac/v1/search/ across all collections, filtered by bbox/datetime/collections/limit.

**Files:**
- Create: backend/stac_api/search.py
- Modify: backend/stac_api/serializers.py (rename _item_geometry_and_datetime -> item_geometry_and_datetime), backend/stac_api/views.py, backend/stac_api/urls.py
- Create: backend/stac_api/tests/test_search.py

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] no params returns all items up to limit
- [ ] bbox filters by overlap
- [ ] datetime interval filters (open-ended both directions via '..')
- [ ] collections param restricts scope
- [ ] GET and POST both work with same filters
- [ ] malformed bbox/datetime/limit -> 400 not 500

**Verify:** sudo docker compose exec backend uv run python manage.py test stac_api.tests.test_search -v 2, then full stac_api suite

See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-20-stac-api.md Task 6 for full code.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["backend/stac_api/search.py", "backend/stac_api/serializers.py", "backend/stac_api/views.py", "backend/stac_api/urls.py"], "verifyCommand": "sudo docker compose exec backend uv run python manage.py test stac_api -v 2", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no-param search returns all items", "bbox overlap filter correct", "datetime interval filter correct incl open-ended", "collections filter correct", "GET and POST parity", "malformed params return 400"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Scoped OpenAPI schema + docs
tasks.description:
**Goal:** /api/stac/v1/schema/ and /api/stac/v1/docs/, scoped only to stac_api routes with their own title/description, via drf-spectacular's per-view custom_settings (not the global SPECTACULAR_SETTINGS).

**Files:**
- Modify: backend/stac_api/urls.py
- Create: backend/stac_api/tests/test_schema.py

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] schema info.title == 'GeoQuery STAC API'
- [ ] schema paths cover exactly the stac_api routes, no public_api/internal leakage
- [ ] docs page renders 200

**Verify:** sudo docker compose exec backend uv run python manage.py test stac_api.tests.test_schema -v 2

See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-20-stac-api.md Task 7 for full code.

tasks.subject: Task 8: Spec-conformance validation tests (stac-pydantic)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add stac-pydantic as a test-only dependency and validate representative Collection/Item/ItemCollection payloads against the real STAC JSON Schema.

**Files:**
- Modify: pyproject.toml (repo root, dependency-groups + default-groups)
- Create: backend/stac_api/tests/test_spec_conformance.py

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] stac-pydantic installed and importable in the backend container
- [ ] Dataset- and FeatureCollection-backed Collections validate via stac_pydantic.Collection
- [ ] DatasetResource- and boundary-backed Items validate via stac_pydantic.Item
- [ ] items list and search responses validate via stac_pydantic.ItemCollection

**Verify:** uv lock && uv sync --package geoquery-backend; sudo docker compose build backend worker && sudo docker compose up -d backend worker; sudo docker compose exec backend uv run python manage.py test stac_api.tests.test_spec_conformance -v 2

See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-20-stac-api.md Task 8 for full code.
